source.outcome_status: opened development evidence; no result from this study is confirmatory
source.time_status: GitHub pull-request createdAt projection with public outcomes projected to Task arrival; source-time-safe counterfactual only

research_contract.target: Determine whether a target repository's observable response-composition history contains a transferable pre-Origin increment for predicting the next Task cohort, before implementing another budgeted Selector.
research_contract.runtime_boundary: The deployed input remains one target repository and its local Task Pool and cached reference-Agent Results. Other repositories contribute only one source-time-safe shrinkage prior and never candidate Tasks.
research_contract.claim_boundary: Passing the signal cascade may justify one experiment-layer budgeted Selection. It cannot establish strict historical replay, unseen-source portability, prospective validity, or a Runner default.
non_solutions: using the held-out configuration in its own difficulty coordinate
using target future outcomes or hindsight memberships before Selection
using cutoff-later Tasks or projected Results from another repository
promoting static cross-Agent correlation as future-distribution prediction
tuning a window, decay, threshold, number of bins, prior mass, budget, horizon, or gate after replay
opening the sealed SWE-bench Agent holdout
adding a trainer, registry, scheduler, or multi-repository Runner

rolling_origin.repository_sets: reuse the exact H5 wide/deep and H10 common/deep sets from the bound selector plan
rolling_origin.outer_holdout: evaluate each configuration a with a Task difficulty coordinate built from the other 35 configurations only
rolling_origin.training_cutoff: the cross-repository shrinkage prior for target cutoff tau uses only other-repository Tasks with projected created_at no later than tau
rolling_origin.result_availability: public Result is projected to its Task created_at; evidence remains counterfactual

response_coordinate.definition: For held-out configuration a, d[t,a] is the mean binary outcome of the other 35 configurations on Task t.
response_coordinate.held_out_boundary: configuration a is absent from d, expert scoring, global prior, forecast, and Selection

global_prior.definition: At each target Origin, compute each eligible other repository's mean d under the same held-out configuration and average those repository means equally.
global_prior.reason: provide bounded partial pooling without allowing long repositories to dominate

experts: stationary: mean d over all current target history
recent: mean d over the latest h current target Tasks
prequential_forecast.past_evidence: For the current repository Origin, score both experts by absolute error on every earlier complete rolling Origin from the same H5 or H10 schedule.
prequential_forecast.choice: choose the expert with smaller mean earlier loss; ties and the first Origin choose stationary
prequential_forecast.local_mass: history Task count for stationary and h for recent
prequential_forecast.parameters: no decay, minimum gain, third expert, learned weight, Markov state, or outcome-driven tuning

selection_if_signal_passes.rule: For each held-out configuration, choose ten local historical Tasks whose mean d is closest to the frozen forecast by exact dynamic programming over the 36 discrete solved-count capacities.
selection_if_signal_passes.tie_break: lexicographically smallest count vector, then newest projected created_at and instance_id within each solved-count cell

stage_a_cross_agent_response.metric: For each target Origin and held-out configuration with both terminal classes in target history, compute ROC AUC of d[t,a] for y[t,a]; average configurations, Origins within repository, then repositories equally.
requirements: H5 repository-macro AUC is greater than 0.5
repository bootstrap 95 percent lower bound is greater than 0.5
at least 9 of 13 repositories are greater than 0.5
every leave-one-repository-out macro is greater than 0.5
a configuration-label circular-shift negative control has corrected upper-tail rate below 0.10
stage_a_cross_agent_response.failure_action: retire ALG-014 without evaluating target future increment

stage_b_target_future_increment.metric: absolute error between forecast mean d and the actual future-cohort mean d, evaluated leave-one-configuration-out and aggregated configuration, Origin within repository, then repository equally
controls: prequential chosen local expert without the cross-repository prior
requirements: H5 repository-macro loss is at least 10 percent lower than complete history
at least 10 of 13 H5 repositories and every H5 leave-one-repository-out view are favorable
H5 deep difference is negative
H5 loss is no higher than recent and no-prior controls
H10 common-11 and deep differences are negative with at least 8 of 11 repositories favorable
short- and long-calendar-span H5 groups are both favorable
one hundred ninety-nine repository-block circular shifts give a corrected lower-tail rate below 0.10
recent expert selection rate is between 0.10 and 0.90
stage_b_target_future_increment.failure_action: retire ALG-014 and stop candidate invention on the current opened sources

stage_c_budgeted_selection.run_condition: all Stage A and Stage B requirements pass exactly
requirements: H5 repository-macro difference is at most -0.010
at least 10 of 13 H5 repositories and every leave-one-repository-out view are favorable
H5 deep difference is negative
H10 common-11 and deep differences are negative with at least 8 of 11 repositories favorable
H5 is better than at least 75 percent of random draws and H10 is not below the random median
leave-one-model, leave-one-harness, leave-one-language, and model-by-harness double holdouts do not reverse aggregate direction
a target-history circular-shift null has corrected lower-tail rate below 0.10
stage_c_budgeted_selection.failure_action: retire ALG-014 and stop candidate invention on the current opened sources

report: configuration, model, harness, and language directions if Selection is reached
negative controls and exact stopping decision
